cards.name: Departure from the Havens
cards.text: Setup: Prepare the Corsair deck. Players prepare their fleet. Shuffle each stage 2 card in the quest deck so that their order is random, leaving stage 3 on the bottom. Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Rolling Seas and 1 copy of Scouting Ship, and add them to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Sailing. While you are on-course (o), each Ship objective gets +2 [willpower]. When this stage is defeated, if you are on-course (o), look at the top 2 stages of the quest deck and advance to one of your choice, placing the other on the bottom of the quest deck. Otherwise, advance to the top stage of the quest deck.

cards.name: Dream-chaser
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects. Sentinel.
The Dream-chaser can always be committed to Sailing tests (even if you are not the first player), and counts as 2 characters when committed to a Sailing test.   If the Dream-chaser is destroyed, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Scouting Ship
cards.text:
Boarding 1. Cannot have attachments.
Scouting Ship gets -15 engagement cost while you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ).

cards.name: Calm Waters
cards.text: While Calm Waters is the active location, look at 2 additional cards from the top of the encounter deck during each Sailing test.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if attacking enemy is a Ship enemy).

cards.name: Vicious Marauder
cards.text: Forced: When Vicious Marauder engages you, discard a random card from your hand and place resources on it equal to that card's printed cost.  Forced: When Vicious Marauder attacks you, distribute damage among characters you control equal to the number of resources on it.

cards.name: Into the Storm
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Waterspout and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Sailing. Forced: At the end of the quest phase, if you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ), each player must distribute 5 damage among characters he controls. When this stage is defeated, if you are on-course (o), look at the top 2 stages of the quest deck and advance to one of your choice, placing the other on the bottom of the quest deck. Otherwise, advance to the top stage of the quest deck.

cards.name: Umbar Captain
cards.text: While you are engaged with Umbar Captain, characters you control cannot attack Ship enemies.

cards.name: Boarding Party
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player reveals the top card of the Corsair deck and puts it into play, engaged with him.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if you control an exhausted Ship objective).

cards.name: Voyage Across Belegaer
cards.text: Rulesheet Card 3

cards.name: Rough Waters
cards.text: While Rough Waters is in the staging area, cancel the first 1 symbol found during each Sailing test.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ), attacking enemy gets +2 [attack].

cards.name: Nárelenya
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects. Sentinel.
Reduce the cost of the first ally you play each round by 1.  If Narelenya is destroyed, its controller is eliminated from the game.

cards.name: Cunning Pirate
cards.text:
Cunning Pirate gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] for each resource on it.
Forced: When Cunning Pirate engages you, discard an attachment you control and place resources on Cunning Pirate equal to that attachment's printed cost.

cards.name: Waterspout
cards.text: While your heading is at the worst setting ( 3/4 ), when faced with the option to travel, the players must travel to Waterspout, if able. Forced: After traveling to Waterspout, deal 4 damage to each Ship objective.

cards.name: Thrown Off Course
cards.text: When Revealed: Either remove all progress from the current quest and raise each player's threat by 4, or shift your heading off-course.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, shift your heading off-course.

cards.name: Winds of Wrath
cards.text: When Revealed: If you are off-course, deal 1 damage to each character in play. If your heading is at the worst setting ( 3/4 ), this effect cannot be canceled.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Either shift your heading off-course or treat this attack as undefended.

cards.name: Sudden Storms
cards.text: When Revealed: Either shift your heading off-course or deal 1 damage to each exhausted character.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Excess damage from this attack is dealt to a Ship objective you control.

cards.name: Dawn Star
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects. Sentinel.
Raise your starting threat by 3. Draw 1 additional card during the resource phase. If the Dawn Star is destroyed, its controller is eliminated from the game.

cards.name: Voyage Across Belegaer
cards.text: Rulesheet Card 5

cards.name: Corsair Warship
cards.text:
Boarding 3. Cannot have attachments.
While Corsair Warship is in the staging area, it cannot be damaged and gains archery 4.

cards.name: Corsair Pursuit
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Ship enemy with the highest [threat] and add it to the staging area (2 Ship enemies with the highest [threat] instead if there are 3 or more players in the game). Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Sailing. You cannot place progress on Corsair Pursuit unless you are on-course (o). If there are no Ship enemies in play, you have defeated your pursuers, and win the game. If this stage has 10 or more progress on it, you have lost your pursuers, and win the game.

cards.name: Cursed Mists
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Fog Bank and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Sailing. While you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ), each non-Ship ally gets -2 [willpower]. When this stage is defeated, if you are on-course (o), look at the top 2 stages of the quest deck and advance to one of your choice, placing the other on the bottom of the quest deck. Otherwise, advance to the top stage of the quest deck.

cards.name: Southron Sailor
cards.text: While Southron Sailor is engaged with you, each Ship enemy engaged with you contributes its [threat] to the total [threat] in the staging area.

cards.name: Starlit Sea
cards.text: While you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ), Uncharted Ocean gains: "Travel: Raise each player's threat by 3."
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if you are off-course).

cards.name: Calphon's Divination
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Scouting Ship and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Sailing. While you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ), each Ship enemy gains Boarding 1. When this stage is defeated, if you are on-course (o), look at the top 2 stages of the quest deck and advance to one of your choice, placing the other on the bottom of the quest deck. Otherwise, advance to the top stage of the quest deck.

cards.name: Light Cruiser
cards.text:
Boarding 2. Cannot have attachments.
Each Raider enemy revealed from the Corsair deck by Light Cruiser's boarding keyword enters play with 1 resource on it.

cards.name: Voyage Across Belegaer
cards.text: Rulesheet Card 1

cards.name: Silver Wing
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects. Sentinel. Ranged.
Reduce your starting threat by 3. Each hero you control gets +1 [attack]. If the Silver Wing is destroyed, its controller is eliminated from the game.

cards.name: The Star's Guidance
cards.text: When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Starlit Sea and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Sailing. While you are off-course ( 1/4 ,  1/2 , or  3/4 ), each Ocean location gets +1 [threat]. When this stage is defeated, if you are on-course (o), look at the top 2 stages of the quest deck and advance to one of your choice, placing the other on the bottom of the quest deck. Otherwise, advance to the top stage of the quest deck.

cards.name: Rolling Seas
cards.text: Travel: Shift your heading off-course to travel here.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack deals damage to a Ship objective, shift your heading off-course.

cards.name: Fog Bank
cards.text: While Fog Bank is the active location, Ship enemies do not make engagement checks, cannot attack, and cannot be attacked.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If your heading is at the worst setting ( 3/4 ), attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.
